note: Guard probes for the Channel 0.2 verification gates. Each entry names a mutation that makes one guard's own subject present in the package, and the verdict that guard must return. It is the corpus three condition-4 passes rebuilt by hand from the prose of the pass before -- AM's review records its probes in sentences, AN's re-derived them from those sentences, and this pass re-derived them again and could not set four of them up because the text they anchored on had been corrected. That is section 1.1 of the verification foundation plan about evaluators, arriving one level up: the instrument is rebuilt every cycle and thrown away. This file is that instrument kept. `build/verify-channel-0.2-guards.ps1` runs it.

authority.note: A probe is evidence about a guard, never a statement about the design. Where a probe and an artifact disagree about what the design says, the artifact is right and the probe is the defect. A probe that no longer applies is deleted with the guard it was written for, in the same change, and never left failing.
